evidence.text: Categories: Café Svedjan Bageri Visit Stockholm Svedjan offers its patrons a taste of northern Sweden. Since 2020, the bakery/café offers home-made sandwiches, exquisite pastries, and freshly brewed coffee. All dairy products used are from the eponymous farm, managed by the owners parents.
